# Huntr alternative: tracking applications doesn't tell you why you're not getting interviews

Updated July 2026  ·  7 min read

Job trackers can show what happened. The real challenge is understanding why it happened. Here is where Huntr helps, where candidates get stuck, and what to focus on instead.

Quick answer

Huntr is a well-designed job application tracker, but tracking alone does not explain why applications are not converting to interviews. The strongest Huntr alternatives combine tracking with fit analysis. HireKey, for example, uses recruiter-level evaluation to assess whether your background aligns with the role before you apply, so effort goes to the applications most likely to succeed. [...] HireKey is a recruiter-informed job-search platform that connects resume tailoring, role-fit analysis, interview preparation, company research, and application tracking in one workflow. HireKey will offer a free plan when it launches in September 2026. Premium will be $39/month, billed monthly with no annual commitment.

For many candidates, the right approach uses both. Organize your search, then understand why it is or is not converting. The first step gives you visibility. The second step gives you insight. Visibility without insight makes the problem easier to track, not easier to solve.

The one thing to remember

Job trackers tell you what happened.  
Strategy tells you why it happened.
